title: RHEL 10 must have the "nss-tools" package installed.
check_content:
Verify RHEL 10 has the "nss-tools" package installed with the following command:

$ sudo dnf list --installed nss-tools
Installed Packages
nss-tools.x86_64                           3.112.0-4.el10_0                           @rhel-10-for-x86_64-appstream-rpms

If the "nss-tools" package is not installed, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Configure RHEL 10 to have the "nss-tools" package installed with the following command:

$ sudo dnf -y install nss-tools
VulnDiscussion: Network Security Services (NSS) is a set of libraries designed to support cross-platform development of security-enabled client and server applications. Install the "nss-tools" package to install command-line tools to manipulate the NSS certificate and key database.
